status: PROVISIONAL design proposal (2026-11-09), not a team decision. Any facade instruction from the team overrides it: put it in the proposal's perspective/facades_override.json, or change this file by pull request.
rule: One facade system per building, the same on every floor and bay, ground floor included; never mix systems on one building.

ftc.what: floor-to-ceiling glazing in every bay, a glass rail on the upper floors

horizontal.what: one long horizontal window per bay

louver.what: floor-to-ceiling openings, each behind vertical timber slats

punched.what: building-types' rule: one 1.4 m window per bay
